description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
